# Rounding parameterized NUMERIC and BIGNUMERIC fields in STRUCTs and ARRAYs.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/data-definition-language.md
#
# Expected values and errors were confirmed against BigQuery.
# Each script creates its own table in the scalars fixture.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_struct_insert (s STRUCT<even NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN'), away NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_AWAY_FROM_ZERO'), plain NUMERIC(5, 1), big BIGNUMERIC(10, 0) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_struct_insert VALUES (STRUCT(NUMERIC '2.25', NUMERIC '-2.25', NUMERIC '2.25', BIGNUMERIC '2.5'));
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(s) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_struct_insert
=> "{\"even\":\"2.2\",\"away\":\"-2.3\",\"plain\":\"2.3\",\"big\":2}"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_scalar_array (a ARRAY<NUMERIC(5, 1)> OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN'));
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_scalar_array VALUES ([NUMERIC '2.25', NUMERIC '-2.25', NUMERIC '2.35']);
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(a) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_scalar_array
=> "[\"2.2\",\"-2.2\",\"2.4\"]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_struct_array (a ARRAY<STRUCT<n NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN'), label STRING>>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_struct_array VALUES ([STRUCT(NUMERIC '2.25', 'first'), STRUCT(NUMERIC '-2.25', 'second'), STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC), 'null')]);
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(a) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_struct_array
=> "[{\"n\":\"2.2\",\"label\":\"first\"},{\"n\":\"-2.2\",\"label\":\"second\"},{\"n\":null,\"label\":\"null\"}]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_deep_struct (s STRUCT<inner_value STRUCT<n NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>, a ARRAY<BIGNUMERIC(10, 0)> OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_deep_struct VALUES (STRUCT(STRUCT(NUMERIC '2.25'), [BIGNUMERIC '2.5', BIGNUMERIC '-2.5']));
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(s) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_deep_struct
=> "{\"inner_value\":{\"n\":\"2.2\"},\"a\":[2,-2]}"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_null_struct (s STRUCT<n NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_null_struct VALUES (NULL);
SELECT s IS NULL FROM scalars.nested_rounding_null_struct
=> "true"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_empty_array (a ARRAY<STRUCT<n NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_empty_array VALUES ([]);
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(a) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_empty_array
=> "[]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_null_array_element (a ARRAY<NUMERIC(5, 1)> OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN'));
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_null_array_element VALUES ([NUMERIC '2.25', NULL]);
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(a) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_null_array_element
=> error contains: Array cannot have a null element; error in writing field a

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_struct_update (s STRUCT<n NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN'), label STRING>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_struct_update VALUES (STRUCT(NUMERIC '0', 'before'));
UPDATE scalars.nested_rounding_struct_update SET s = STRUCT(NUMERIC '-2.25', 'after') WHERE TRUE;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(s) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_struct_update
=> "{\"n\":\"-2.2\",\"label\":\"after\"}"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_field_update (s STRUCT<n NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN'), away NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_AWAY_FROM_ZERO')>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_field_update VALUES (STRUCT(NUMERIC '0', NUMERIC '0'));
UPDATE scalars.nested_rounding_field_update SET s.n = NUMERIC '2.25', s.away = NUMERIC '2.25' WHERE TRUE;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(s) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_field_update
=> "{\"n\":\"2.2\",\"away\":\"2.3\"}"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_array_update (a ARRAY<NUMERIC(5, 1)> OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN'));
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_array_update VALUES ([]);
UPDATE scalars.nested_rounding_array_update SET a = [NUMERIC '2.25', NUMERIC '-2.25'] WHERE TRUE;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(a) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_array_update
=> "[\"2.2\",\"-2.2\"]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_overflow (s STRUCT<n NUMERIC(2, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_overflow VALUES (STRUCT(NUMERIC '9.95'));
SELECT CAST(s.n AS STRING) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_overflow
=> error contains: Field s: NUMERIC(2, 1) has precision 2 and scale 1 but got a value that is not in range of [-9.9, 9.9]

# CTAS uses the same rounding for nested fields, including a mode inherited from the table.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_ctas (s STRUCT<n NUMERIC(5, 1)>, a ARRAY<BIGNUMERIC(10, 0)>) OPTIONS (default_rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') AS SELECT STRUCT(NUMERIC '2.25' AS n) AS s, [BIGNUMERIC '2.5', BIGNUMERIC '-2.5'] AS a;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(t) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_ctas AS t
=> "{\"s\":{\"n\":\"2.2\"},\"a\":[2,-2]}"

# Additional nested rounding cases for INSERT SELECT, MERGE, NULLs and wide BIGNUMERIC values.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_insert_select (s STRUCT<n NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_insert_select SELECT STRUCT(n AS different_name) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '2.25']) AS n;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(s) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_insert_select
=> "{\"n\":\"2.2\"}"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_merge_values (id INT64, s STRUCT<n NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_merge_values VALUES (1, STRUCT(NUMERIC '0'));
MERGE scalars.nested_rounding_merge_values AS t USING (SELECT id, STRUCT(NUMERIC '2.25' AS n) AS s FROM UNNEST([1, 2]) AS id) AS source ON t.id = source.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET s = source.s WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, s) VALUES (source.id, source.s);
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(s ORDER BY id)) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_merge_values
=> "[{\"n\":\"2.2\"},{\"n\":\"2.2\"}]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_null_children (s STRUCT<child STRUCT<n NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>, n NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_null_children VALUES (STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<n NUMERIC>), CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC)));
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(s) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_null_children
=> "{\"child\":null,\"n\":null}"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_wide_numeric (a ARRAY<STRUCT<n BIGNUMERIC(40, 38) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>>, s STRUCT<n NUMERIC(2, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_wide_numeric VALUES ([STRUCT(BIGNUMERIC '1.00000000000000000000000000000000000005')], STRUCT(NUMERIC '9.85'));
SELECT CONCAT(CAST(a[OFFSET(0)].n AS STRING), ',', CAST(s.n AS STRING)) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_wide_numeric
=> "1.00000000000000000000000000000000000005,9.8"

# NULL arrays and STRUCT elements when writing nested parameterized rounding fields.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_null_arrays (a ARRAY<NUMERIC(5, 1)> OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN'), s STRUCT<a ARRAY<NUMERIC(5, 1)> OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_null_arrays VALUES (CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<NUMERIC>), STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<NUMERIC>)));
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(t) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_null_arrays AS t
=> "{\"a\":[],\"s\":{\"a\":[]}}"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_null_struct_element (a ARRAY<STRUCT<n NUMERIC(5, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_null_struct_element VALUES ([STRUCT(NUMERIC '2.25'), CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<n NUMERIC>)]);
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(a) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_null_struct_element
=> error contains: Array cannot have a null element; error in writing field a

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.nested_rounding_field_overflow (s STRUCT<n NUMERIC(2, 1) OPTIONS (rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN')>);
INSERT scalars.nested_rounding_field_overflow VALUES (STRUCT(NUMERIC '0'));
UPDATE scalars.nested_rounding_field_overflow SET s.n = NUMERIC '9.95' WHERE TRUE;
SELECT CAST(s.n AS STRING) FROM scalars.nested_rounding_field_overflow
=> error contains: NUMERIC(2, 1) has precision 2 and scale 1 but got a value that is not in range of [-9.9, 9.9]
